newsitem.title: UK: India buys four cargoes December Dubai crude.
newsitem.headline: India buys four cargoes December Dubai crude.

text.p: The Indian Oil Corp (IOC) bought four cargoes of Dubai crude in its December purchase tender which was awarded on Friday, traders said.
Two cargoes were taken from Wall Street trader Phibro at first half month quotes plus 57 and 58 cents and one each from Total and Statoil at plus 57 and plus 59 cents respectively, traders said.
Some of the awards could not be immediately confirmed with the successful bidders.
IOC also bought four Dubai cargoes in its November tender.
It was not immediately clear whether IOC bought any of the other crude grades -- Nigerian Qua Iboe, Egyptian Gulf of Suez or Oman -- offered into the December tender.
Six Dubai cargoes in total were offered into the tender. Dubai intermonth spreads firmed slightly in response to the award, with Dec/Jan and Jan/Feb bid three cents higher at +53 cents.
IOC was expected to buy two or three of the four VLCCs of Qua Iboe offered, traders said.
